profile.headline: Software Engineer

positions.title: Peer Leader at the Entering Student Program
positions.description:
• Worked 12 hours a week to collaborate with the course instructor to provide instructional leadership for University 1301
• Met weekly with the assigned course instructor to assist him in planning the curriculum and instructional activities throughout the semester
• Helped students become independent learners by being able to develop new teaching methods to facilitate student’s learning

company.name: The University of Texas at El Paso

positions.title: Engineering Peer Advisor at Engineering Programs for Achievement, Success, and Opportunity (E-PASO)
positions.description:
• Provide ongoing mentoring to 350+ students in course selections, including the university’s registration tool support. 
•Directed 3 info sessions to new students on a weekly basis, which included registration process, and tutorials on utilizing the University enterprise tools such as Banner and Goldmine
•Connected these students to available resources and opportunities by working with faculty and staff at the University
•Worked 19 hours a week as a peer advisor to students entering the college of engineering in person or by phone.
